title: Pondering Pearl Pufferfish
statement: A small, thoughtful pufferfish who collects single grains of glowing sand and carries them in her mouth to a quiet pearl-shaped stone at the center of her tank. When she's pleased with her arrangement, she puffs up into a soft, round lantern and hovers in the amber light, wobbling slightly. Around her, slow ribbons of kelp and a few lopsided teacups sway in the current.
